limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation is pending.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation: one-bit combinational AND derived from all four input combinations in the original waveform. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench replays all 19 original waveform timestamps, samples after delta-cycle settling, and checks five additional input-transition boundaries with literal expected values. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule has one-bit inputs a and b and one-bit output q, with no clock, reset, state, or added latency.
static_review: Single continuous assignment, no inferred storage, no extra ports, unsigned one-bit operands.
